description: A photograph depicting four cows grazing in a dry, rocky, and sparsely vegetated alpine or subalpine grassland. Two brown cows are positioned on the left, one brown cow in the centre, and one white and brown cow on the right. The foreground features patchy dry grass, exposed soil, and scattered rocks, indicative of an alpine environment. In the background, a steep hillside covered with green vegetation, likely shrubs or sparse trees, ascends under a clear blue sky. The image illustrates traditional transhumance grazing in natural grasslands above the tree line, which occasionally includes low fractions of bare rock or gravel, shrubs, and sporadic trees, aligning with the EUNIS Habitat Classification E4.
